In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''dancer''' worked in [[Slugfall Cantina]] within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. A representative of the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] granted the dancer with a donation to help her get back to her family on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dash" />
